perspectives.title: Public Executions
arguments: Public executions promote a culture of death
Public executions are messages of control to the populace
Public executions are not about justice but about instilling fear

representative_posts.text: "Inherent dignity of every human person dictates that no matter the severity of an individual's crimes, the State must never reduce justice to a barbaric public spectacle. A public execution promotes a culture of death that erodes our social fabric." Join:

Someone else pointed this out, so I’ll parrot it. Public executions are messages directed at the populace, not the criminal. I bring this up because this annnouncement reveals their desperation. Stand tall.
Sick and cruel, yes. But more importantly, public executions are messages from a regime bent on keeping the population under control.

Televised executions aren’t about justice. ICE killings, extrajudicial executions via boat strikes, and now livestreamed firing squads aren’t about law and order. This is a direct message to the public: the State can and will exercise total power over human life without limits.
